scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:bundle
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:engine && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:engine: tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/unit/utils/*.test.ts tests/unit/core/*.test.ts tests/unit/services/*.test.ts tests/unit/engine/probability-mass-bookkeeper.test.ts tests/unit/engine/search/search-state-tracker.test.ts tests/unit/engine/progressive.test.ts tests/unit/engine/engine-checkpoint-search.test.ts tests/unit/engine/engine.test.ts tests/unit/engine/engine-invariants.test.ts tests/unit/engine/prob-conservation.test.ts tests/infra/*.test.ts tests/integration/mechanics.test.ts tests/integration/integration.test.ts tests/integration/refinement-chart.integration.test.ts tests/diagnostics/*.test.ts tests/unit/engine/engine.snapshots.test.ts
scripts.benchmark:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const files = fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f => f.endsWith('.cpuprofile')); console.log(`Cleaning ${files.length} root profiles...`); files.forEach(f => fs.unlinkSync(f));"
scripts.release: npm run test:all && npm run build:standalone
